headline: Congress named the Port Washington, Wisconsin post office at 104 East Main Street after Joseph G. Demler.
what_it_does: This law renames a specific United States Postal Service building in Port Washington, Wisconsin, as the Joseph G. Demler Post Office. It does not change how the post office runs, what services it offers, or what it costs to use. The name change is ceremonial.
when_it_takes_effect: The law became effective when it was enacted on December 30, 2020.
